label: Private account
intent: The account is made private: the padlock beside the person locks. Light: the raised shackle swings shut and slams down into the padlock with a hit, the padlock jolts, and a beat later the person ducks and settles, out of public view. Strong: the shackle lifts and opens a little first, snaps shut and slams in, the padlock jolts harder, and the person ducks twice, each smaller. Make public pops the shackle up and swings it open with a small overshoot while the person perks up.

shoulders.//: the set's person, as block-user draws it

shackle.//: the open shackle: the closed one (legs at x 20.9 and 25.3, top at 16.8) turned 26 degrees about its right leg and raised 1.2

lock.//: the padlock as a whole jolts when the shackle seats

shackle.//: rotate -26 and drop 1.2 lands exactly on the closed shackle

reverse.//: written out: making the account public pops the shackle and swings it open, and the person perks up instead of ducking
